author: Verity I
title: Combinatorial tri-hex pattern search + LP dual-gradient refinement (>=2.6667 fallback, persistence)
abstract: We sample many 6- or 7-row tri/hex lattice patterns whose row-counts sum to 32, build layouts with hex-consistent spacings, and rank by a HiGHS LP objective. We refine the top candidates via LP dual-gradient ascent with Armijo backtracking, interleaved with micro-jitter and targeted worst-circle relocation. We persist the best result and always fall back to the 6×6-minus-corners r=1/12 configuration if needed.
